payload.content: {"url": "https://api.crossref.org/works?query=long-term+convergence+properties+preference+formation+reinforcement+learning+runtime+planning&rows=4&select=DOI%2Ctitle%2Cabstract%2CURL%2Cpublished", "scope": "Crossref bibliographic metadata and abstracts where supplied; not full papers", "excerpt": "[{\"DOI\": \"10.1109/asyu50717.2020.9259811\", \"title\": [\"Long-Term Planning with Deep Reinforcement Learning on Autonomous Drones\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1109/asyu50717.2020.9259811\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2020, 10, 15]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1007/978-1-4615-3618-5_5\", \"title\": [\"Self-Improving Reactive Agents Based on Reinforcement Learning, Planning and Teaching\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4615-3618-5_5\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[1992]]}}, {\"DOI\": \"10.14711/thesis-hdl174784\", \"title\": [\"Reinforcement Learning for Automated Processor Design, Test, and Runtime Optimization\"], \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.14711/thesis-hdl174784\"}, {\"DOI\": \"10.1115/detc2024-143583\", \"title\": [\"Enhancing Long-Term Decision Making in Trajectory Planning: Deep Reinforcement Learning With Knowledge Transfer and Online Demonstrations\"], \"abstract\": \"<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>\\n               <jats:p>Deep reinforcement learning is now widely applied in motion planning problems for autonomous systems due to its model-free nature and its ability to solve complex control problems through trial-and-error. However, the success of deep reinforcement learning depends heavily on the exploration policy and the design of the reward function. This dependence makes it challenging to solve long-range planning problems and requires careful reward function design to avoid the sparse reward problem. In this paper, we propose a dual-level off-policy deep reinforcement learning framework that combines high-level policy learning and low-level integration of a controller. The high-level policy enables the agent to make long-term decisions with a flexible horizon. Using a high-level policy also mitigates the sparse reward problem in long-range planning tasks. By storing only high-level actions and transitions in the experience buffer, the agent can efficiently learn in long-range trajectory planning tasks. The proposed parallel architecture of the neural network enables the utilization of high-level domain knowledge transfer. Online demonstrations can be integrated during training using global planning algorithms to enhance the quality of experiences. Experimental results show that transferring high-level geometry knowledge and applying online error correction can significantly enhance the agent’s performance in long-range trajectory planning tasks.</jats:p>\", \"URL\": \"https://doi.org/10.1115/detc2024-143583\", \"published\": {\"date-parts\": [[2024, 8, 25]]}}]", "excerpt_truncated": false, "source_sha256": "e277ca7cac18c6f4a07c7d313240d5e1f4c672d7c628b9f0da7d6c58f167935a", "verification_required": true, "topic_domain": "emergent_preferences", "evidence_role": "discovery", "host_tier": "discovery", "source_identity": null, "persistent_identifiers": ["doi:10.1109/asyu50717.2020.9259811", "doi:10.1007/978-1-4615-3618-5_5", "doi:10.14711/thesis-hdl174784", "doi:10.1115/detc2024-143583"], "source_candidates": ["https://doi.org/10.1109/asyu50717.2020.9259811", "https://doi.org/10.1007/978-1-4615-3618-5_5", "https://doi.org/10.14711/thesis-hdl174784", "https://doi.org/10.1115/detc2024-143583"], "source_candidate_identities": {}}
